- Patient Goal(s): Reduce anxiety and worry about current symptoms and familial cancer risk; return to normal functioning and work; maintain hydration and nutrition

- Actions (Patient): Adhere to medical advice regarding hydration and symptom monitoring; seek GP review if symptoms worsen or persist beyond expected timeframe; communicate any escalating worry or mood changes
- Actions (Clinician/GP): Reassure regarding probable diagnosis (gastroenteritis); advise fluid intake and symptom monitoring; arrange or recommend follow-up with GP for physical symptom review; assess anxiety and consider referral to mental health support if anxiety or functional impairment persists
